Cc: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@clearhealth.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Demo request: secure inference for patient-facing app

Hi Redwood team,

We signed up via the trial and I wanted to request a 30-min demo to see the platform in action. Quick background: we’re building a patient-facing triage assistant and are evaluating secure, low-latency inference for short clinical prompts (50–150 tokens).

A few quick details to help scope the call:
- Company: ClearHealth (digital health startup)
- Use case: triage + care routing, PHI in prompts
- Current volume: ~10k requests/day today, planning to ramp to 50–100k/day in 6–12 months
- Timeline: decision target Q1 2027, pilot in Dec/Jan if feasible

Can you share a few available slots next week for a live demo? Would like to include our engineering lead (Tom) as well.

Thanks,
Samira
VP Product, ClearHealth
[Sent from ClearHealth signup form]

Hi Samira — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. I’m Marissa on the SDR team at Redwood Inference. Happy to get a 30-min demo scheduled. A few quick qualification questions so we tailor the demo and bring the right teammate: 

1) Is PHI going to be in the prompt text or passed separately (we can walk through Private deployment options if PHI will be present)?
2) Typical sequence length and examples of prompts (average and worst-case token length)?
3) Is low single-digit latency per request required for the user experience?
4) Who on your side needs to be on the demo besides Tom? (engineering, security/compliance?)

We have open slots next week for a 30-min session — pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-30m (attached quick product overview as well).

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- 5m intros and goals
- 10m platform overview (hosting modes, security, SLAs)
- 10m demo: inference latency, cost levers (batching/quantization), deployment options
- 5m next steps / pilot sizing

Attachment: [Attachment: product_overview.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)]

If you prefer, I can also propose two specific slots: Tue 11/24 10:00–10:30 PST or Wed 11/25 14:00–14:30 PST. I’ll invite our AE (Jonas Weber) to join the call to cover pricing and pilot options.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa — quick answers: 
- PHI: yes, prompts will contain PHI for triage context (patient symptoms, DOB redacted where possible). We’re evaluating both hosted with business-associate agreements and Private (VPC) deployments.
- Tokens: typical prompts are 60–120 tokens, worst-case up to ~300 tokens including context and history.
- Latency: ideally <200–300 ms p95 for good UX; we can accept slightly higher for backend batch workflows.
- Attendees: Tom (engineering lead) and our Head of Security (Maya Patel) — she’ll attend if privacy/BAA questions are part of the call.

We can take Wed 11/25 14:00–14:30 PST. Please send an invite and any pre-reads.

Thanks,
Samira
VP Product, ClearHealth
